findings.passage: The right to keep and bear arms, protected by the Second Amendment to the United States Constitution, is a fundamental freedom. I support the rights of law-abiding citizens to own firearms for self-defense, hunting, and sport. Here in Wisconsin, that’s part of our heritage.
findings.note: Guns section of his campaign issues page. The page carries no publication date; the date given is the day it was fetched, so precision is marked unknown.
subjects: Second Amendment as a fundamental right

findings.passage: We should focus on enforcing laws against violent criminals—not placing new burdens on responsible gun owners. I oppose sweeping bans and broad restrictions that undermine constitutional rights without improving public safety.
findings.note: Second paragraph of the Guns section of his campaign issues page. He says he opposes sweeping bans and broad restrictions and prefers enforcing existing laws against violent criminals. No specific bill or measure is named. The page carries no publication date.
subjects: opposes new burdens on gun owners
